Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch,
Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson Counties;
In the State Office of Administrative Hearings

Dear Honorable Judges:

The undersigned represents Abell Ranches, Ltd. (“Abell”) in the above-referenced matter
before SOAH and the Public Utility Commission.

Samuel HV Abell filed his direct Testimony on behalf of Abell Ranches, Ltd. on May 13,
2026 (Interchange Item 4160).

On May 18, 2026 Reliance Ranches, LLC and Chanas Ranch, LLC (“Reliance”) through
their counsel, Brian K. Norman, filed their Motion to Strike Portions of Samuel HV Abell on
Behalf of Abell Ranches, Ltd.’s Direct Testimony (the “Motion” - Interchange Item 4733).

On May 22, 2026, counsel for the Parties reached an agreement on a deadline for Abell’s
response to Reliance’s Motion. Abell will file a Response to Reliance’s Objections and Motion

to Strike by Friday, May 29, 2026 as memorialized in the attached Agreement.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
